results.title: PyroBuildS: Enabling Efficient Exploration of Linux Configuration Space with Incremental Build - Archive ouverte HAL
results.content: June 15, 2023 - Although incremental compilation for post-commit is used in Linux, we show in this paper that the build of large numbers of random Linux configurations does not benefit from incremental build. Thus, we introduce and detail PyroBuildS, our new approach to efficiently explore, with incremental builds, the very large configuration space of Linux.

results.title: Happy Pi Day 2026: Major Feature and Ecosystem Releases Supporting Pioneers and Developers
results.content: These updates include **the release of Pi Launchpad MVP version on Testnet** following one design in recently introduced PiRC for Pioneers to learn and understand the new construct in action, progress in **Node and Protocol Upgrades,** **Second migrations**, and **KYC Validator rewards**, alongside new capabilities like **Mainnet Pi payments in Pi App Studio** to enhance utility. As a reminder of the original design for the validator rewards calculation when the KYC app was launched years ago, each Pioneer who migrates to the Mainnet pays 1 Pi into the pool of rewards to be distributed to KYC human validators. Creators building apps in App Studio can reach an existing ecosystem of over 17.7 million KYC verified Pioneers on Mainnet who can pay in real Pi transacted on the blockchain, and many more millions of Pioneers through the Pi mobile platform. As more Pioneers migrate to Mainnet, build applications, and engage with utilities, the network continues to support Pi’s widely used, utility-driven cryptocurrency ecosystem.
